description: A keep of R-4 instead of a revise that changes its operation is accepted with no events: REGEN-002 applies only to a revise, and R-4's stored add passes revalidation.
section: IMPL §3.3.6 (REGEN-002 applies to revise; keep revalidated from REC-001 on)
